On 19 October 2026 Ren asked for the earlier repository to be read for what can be integrated ("please take a look of this … many insights can be integrated"). The [review](../../SSBX-REPOSITORY-REVIEW.md) found three small general laws, argued there and proved only in instances or not at all, that the spine lacked (§3.2, G1–G3): 机 as a juncture, from 补篇一 §八 and §十一 ([卷二](../../../../../../sources/07-shengsheng-buxi/ssbx-repo/史料/生生不息论_三本文完整版/03_补篇一_间开本_致知版/03_卷二_发生.md), [卷三](../../../../../../sources/07-shengsheng-buxi/ssbx-repo/史料/生生不息论_三本文完整版/03_补篇一_间开本_致知版/04_卷三_判准.md)); a commuting law never merging the pairs of a fixed-point-free symmetry, from [义理·拓扑](<../../../../../../sources/07-shengsheng-buxi/ssbx-repo/义理/拓扑 · 从元到障.md>) §四 and §九; and three-valued revision, from [义理·形式逻辑](<../../../../../../sources/07-shengsheng-buxi/ssbx-repo/义理/形式逻辑 · 从元到推.md>) §三. `Becoming.Branching` has no juncture and no keeping restriction (checked), and `Relabel.Equivariant` is a law of selection, not of a law of change. The earlier Lean for these is instance-only or absent, so each is proved again, prelude-only.

**The question.** Where, on a branching course, is a configuration lost, and what does finding that place ask? What does a law of change do with a difference a symmetry carries? What does revision of what a system says of itself do when a value may stay undecided?

**What is proved.**

- **Junctures** ([Becoming.Junctures](../../../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Junctures.lean)). `x` is a juncture for `s` where it has a step after which `s` can still be had and a step after which it cannot (`Juncture`). A juncture can have `s` again, its two steps differ in outcome, it is possibly drawn, and on the course of `s` it returns (`Juncture.reach`, `Juncture.outcomes_differ`, `Juncture.possiblyDrawn`, `Juncture.returns`): it is where `Branching`'s possibly and necessarily drawn come apart. Where `s` returns, every course from `s` to a configuration that cannot have `s` again passes, not not, a juncture at which the course takes its losing step (`loss_passes_juncture`, `loss_passes_juncture_from`, `PossiblyDrawn.passes_juncture`). The proof walks the course and asks at each configuration whether `s` can still be had; it needs that answer, so the claim is stated up to double negation. Where the answer is given along the course, the juncture is found (`loss_passes_juncture_decided`); for configurations a list holds with steps decided, it is given: a reading of the steps that only rises settles by the list's length (`reach_iff_leads`, `reach_decided_listed`, through `Undecided.settles_within`), and the juncture is found (`loss_passes_juncture_listed`). It cannot be given in general: if every loss of every process had its juncture found, every sequence of truth values would have a `true` or be `false` throughout (`lpo_of_junctures_found`, on the process `Hidden`, where whether `origin` can be had again from `fork` is whether a sequence has a `true`). So the double negation says what the unfolding asks: finding the juncture is deciding whether `s` can still be had again. `keeping P s` keeps the steps after which `s` can still be had and `losing P s` the others; a juncture is where both have a step (`juncture_iff`, by `Iff.rfl`). Keeping can have `s` from where `P` can, keeps `s`, returns to `s` exactly where `P` does, and holds every sub-process of `P` that keeps `s` on that sub-process's course from `s` (`reach_keeping_iff`, `keeping_keeps`, `keeping_returns_iff`, `keeping_greatest`); what it removes on its own course are the losing steps at junctures (`keeping_removes_at_juncture`). Losing never returns to `s` (`losing_not_returns`, `losing_loses`). Where `P` keeps `s` no configuration on its course is a juncture (`no_juncture_of_keeps`): `Many` has a step for every natural number at its one configuration and no juncture, while `OneWay`'s `false`, with two moves, is one (`Many.no_juncture`, `OneWay.juncture`).
- **What a commuting law keeps apart** ([Becoming.Commuting](../../../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Commuting.lean)). Where `T (σ x) = σ (T x)` for every `x` (`Law.Commutes`), the run of the law from `σ x` is the image of its run from `x` (`Law.Commutes.iterate`, on `Law.run`), so where `σ` moves every configuration (`Diagonal.Moves Eq σ`) the two runs are never at one configuration at the same step (`Law.Commutes.apart`); a law that merges them breaks the symmetry (`Law.Commutes.breaks`). Such a law brings no two runs to one configuration at every start, so it is not constant (`Law.Commutes.not_drawn_to_one`); a run resting at `x` has its image resting at `σ x`, and returning carries over to the image (`Law.Commutes.rest_paired`, `Law.Commutes.returns_paired`, the latter as `Branching.Returns` of the law's process); under an exchange a run holding a configuration's image `k` steps on holds every configuration's image `k` steps on and returns at `2k` (`Law.Commutes.paired_halfway`, `Law.Commutes.halfway_returns`); for every naming of the pairs, the law goes alike across them (`Law.Commutes.pairs_lumped`, `Learning.Lumped`, and as a process `Law.Commutes.pairs_goAlike`, `GoAlike`). The run from a configuration `σ` fixes stays where `σ` fixes (`Law.Commutes.keeps_fixed`): with `Relabel.Equivariant.tied`, which keeps a tie through an exchange, it is the fixed case of the structure whose free case is `apart`; the two laws do not overlap. Every map commutes with itself, so `Diagonal.revision_never_rests` is the case `T = σ` (`Law.Commutes.self_apart`). For processes, a symmetry carries reach, returning and, under an exchange, junctures, and every run has a mirror run never at the same configuration at the same step (`Branching.Symmetric.reach`, `.returns`, `.juncture`, `Branching.mirror_apart`); a commuting law is a symmetric process (`Branching.law_symmetric`). In the Changes the complement moves every hexagram (`Hexagram.complement_moves`); waxing and waning never brings a hexagram and its complement to one (`Hexagram.waxWane_apart`); its six steps to the complement are the pair halfway round the return of twelve (`Hexagram.waxWane_halfway`, which gives `twelve_steps` again); Y1's `pairs_goAlike` is the general law's instance (`Hexagram.pairs_goAlike_of_commutes`); the waning into 坤 breaks the symmetry (`Hexagram.wane_breaks`); and the change of one line is symmetric under the complement (`Hexagram.changes_symmetric`, `Hexagram.changes_mirror_apart`). 互 and the four-group of 錯 and 綜 are left to Y3 (`Becoming.HexagramLaws`), which can cite `Law.Commutes.apart`.
- **The third value and revision** ([Becoming.Undecided](../../../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Undecided.lean)). Values `t`, `u`, `f`, with `u` below the decided values in information (`Le`); terms built from sentences and the two decided constants by negation, conjunction and disjunction, with the strong tables, which agree with the two-valued ones on decided values (`eval_embed`). A term with no constant (`ConstantFree`) is undecided where every sentence is (`eval_undecided`), so a system with no constant stays wholly undecided at every stage (`stays_undecided`): revision decides only what a constant decides first. Evaluation is monotone in information (`eval_mono`, `eval_mono_below`). For `N` sentences that speak only of one another (`Closed`), revision from every sentence undecided (`stage`, the run `Law.run` of `revise`) rises at every step and along the run (`stage_up`, `stage_mono`) and settles within `N` steps (`settles`, `settled_from`) at the least fixed point (`stage_fixed`, `stage_le_fixed`, `least_fixed`). The bound is exact: in the chain whose first sentence says true and each next denies the one before, sentence `k` is undecided up to stage `k` and decided after, so `N + 1` sentences are steady at step `N + 1` and not at `N` (`chain_undecided`, `chain_decided`, `chain_exact`). The counting is its own law: readings on a list that only rise, and once steady stay steady, are steady by the list's length (`settles_within`); `Becoming.Junctures` uses it for reach. The liar rests undecided at every stage, and a run of its revision from any start rests exactly where it is undecided (`liar_rests`, `liar_rests_iff`, `neg_fixed_iff`); the truth-teller keeps whatever value it starts with and rests undecided from all undecided (`truthTeller_keeps`, `truthTeller_rests`). Where the two-valued revision of a closed system has no fixed point, every three-valued fixed point, and every run of the three-valued revision that rests, leaves a sentence undecided (`undecided_of_moves`, `least_undecided`, `rest_undecided`, `liar_undecided`); for the liar, the two-valued revision is the run of negation and never rests (`liar_two_valued_run`, `liar_two_valued_never_rests`, by `Diagonal.revision_never_rests`), so the liar never rests with two values and rests undecided with three (`liar_both_sides`). Three-valued negation is monotone and does not move every value (`neg_not_moves`); no monotone map does (`monotone_fixed`, `monotone_not_moves`), and the run of a monotone map from the undecided value rests from its first step (`monotone_run_rests`), so a run from the undecided value that never rests is not of a monotone map (`never_rests_not_monotone`): the gap of `Diagonal.gap_unsaid` needs a map deciding the undecided, which is not monotone (`moves_not_monotone`). A family of three-valued readings within what it reads is still incomplete (`incomplete`, by `Diagonal.fixed_of_complete` with the rotation).

**Connectivity.** The laws are stated on the base: junctures and keeping on processes and traces, the commuting laws and revision on runs of the spine (`Law.run`), and the Changes through `Law.process` and `Branching.Symmetric`. A first draft stated the commuting laws and revision on `Law.orbit` and left 57 theorems apart; restated on runs, only `Undecided.incomplete`, a law of every family of three-valued readings on any type, and the lemma it uses stand apart, and `incomplete` is registered as general structure (its run form for every map moving every value is `DiagonalRuns.incomplete`).

**Readings (the AI's, decided from the work under D45; D52).** 机 is a juncture: the earlier text's "两个延续通向不同的开放之未来", read with "open" as one configuration still to be had; its profile of openness is not formalized. 护闭 is keeping, the largest closure that keeps `s` to be had again on its course from `s`; 成闭 is losing, after which `s` never returns. Neither carries a value: which configuration is kept, and whether keeping it supports or damages 生生, goes through §6.15. Many options make no juncture, as the earlier text said (two options are needed, not sufficient). The earlier topology's "«一» structurally does not exist" and its table equating Borsuk–Ulam with the second law are not taken; what is taken is the law: to merge what a symmetry carries, a law must break it. The third value 疑 is what revision has not decided, not a third truth and not superposition (the review's guardrail "不确定 ≠ 不可知"); the earlier "三值保守律" (U ⇏ ⊤) is `eval_undecided` for terms without constants and, along the run, `stays_undecided`.

**Counter-review (the author's).** (1) *Is the juncture law a renaming of `possiblyDrawn_iff`?* No: `possiblyDrawn_iff` says a loss exists on some course; the juncture law says where on the course it happens and what finding it asks, with the LPO calibration as the boundary of the `∃` form. (2) *Is `keeping` greatest in the right sense?* A sub-process that keeps `s` may take steps anywhere off its course from `s`; `keeping_greatest` constrains exactly the steps on that course, which is what keeping `s` concerns. (3) *Is G2 trivial?* The proof is three lines; the law is that commuting is enough, with no involution, finiteness or decision, and its content is in its cases: the diagonal's rhythm, the received pairing, the waning that breaks it. (4) *Does the three-valued settling need the closure hypothesis?* Yes: a sentence speaking of sentences outside the first `N` lets their revision reach in; `Closed` names it. (5) *Is the settling empty?* Without constants it would be: every stage is wholly undecided (`stays_undecided`), the first draft's case, which the review's G3 bullet (terms without constants) states. With constants revision decides, and the chain shows that `N` steps are needed (`chain_exact`). (6) *Independent review*: none by a person; the statements were checked against the review's §3.2 bullet by bullet.

**What would change it.** A process in which every loss has a juncture found without deciding reach (it would refute `lpo_of_junctures_found`'s reading only if LPO held there); a law commuting with a fixed-point-free map that merges a pair (impossible by `apart`); a closed system whose least fixed point is decided while its two-valued revision has no fixed point (impossible by `least_undecided`).
